name.full: Stale Agent Review for Copilot Cowork

description.short: Read-only review of unused agents, agent identities and blueprints
description.full: Finds Copilot agents nobody uses, Entra agent identities that haven't signed in and agent identity blueprints with nothing active under them, and says what to block or disable. Reads agent identities, blueprints and sign-in activity through the Microsoft MCP Server for Enterprise. Read-only.
